assessments.reasoning: The Blocks section on printed p. 31 distinguishes forming a block object from executing the bracketed expressions, and says the described sequence executes when the block receives unary value. Its examples use blocks without formal arguments.

challenge.method: Read the p. 31 block storage example and continuation on p. 32. Separate evaluating a block-expression object, storing it, sending unary value, and argument-bearing or return behavior.
challenge.results: Constructing or storing the no-argument block does not perform the enclosed actions. The adjacent p. 32 example demonstrates that unary value performs them in this documented scope.

limitations: The claim concerns the no-argument block described on this page.
Argument-bearing evaluation messages, closure lifetime, nonlocal returns and virtual-machine shortcuts are separate questions.
The exact edition and claim locator were reviewed from the registered publication.
